courses.title: SYSTEMIC ANATOMY OF THE HUMAN BODY
courses.antireqText: Health Sciences 1300A/B, Health Sciences 2300A/B, Health Sciences 3300A/B, Kinesiology 1060A/B, Kinesiology 2222A/B, Kinesiology 3222A/B, Nursing 1330A/B, the former Health Sciences 2330A/B.

courses.title: FUNCTIONAL HUMAN NEUROANATOMY
courses.prereqText: Registration in third or fourth year. A background in introductory biology is recommended.
courses.antireqText: Health Sciences 3300A/B, Kinesiology 3222A/B, Rehabilitation Sciences 3062A/B, the former Anatomy and Cell Biology 2221, the former Anatomy and Cell Biology 3319.

courses.title: HUMAN EMBRYOLOGY
courses.prereqText: Anatomy and Cell Biology 2200A/B with a minimum mark of 70%.

courses.title: MAMMALIAN HISTOLOGY
courses.prereqText: Registration in third or fourth year. Note: This course is recommended for students with a background in introductory biology.

courses.title: CELL BIOLOGY OF HUMAN DISEASE
courses.prereqText: Biology 2290F/G and Biology 2382A/B with marks of at least 60% in each.
courses.antireqText: The former Anatomy and Cell Biology 4429A.

courses.title: MODERN APPROACHES IN BIOMEDICAL RESEARCH
courses.prereqText: Biology 2382A/B with a mark of at least 60%; and one of Biology 2290F/G or Biology 2581A/B with a mark of at least 60%. Pre-or Corequisite(s): One of Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309, Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A.

courses.title: CADAVERIC ANATOMY: MUSCULOSKELETAL
courses.prereqText: Registration in Year 4 and either (a minimum mark of 80% in Anatomy and Cell Biology 2200A/B) or (a minimum mark of 80% in one of Health Sciences 2300A/B, Kinesiology 1060A/B or Kinesiology 2222A/B; plus a minimum mark of 80% in one of Health Sciences 3300A/B or Kinesiology 3222A/B).
courses.antireqText: The former Anatomy and Cell Biology 2221.

courses.title: CADAVERIC ANATOMY: ORGANS & SYSTEMS
courses.prereqText: Registration in Year 4 and either (a minimum mark of 80% in Anatomy and Cell Biology 2200A/B) or (a minimum mark of 80% in one of Health Sciences 2300A/B, Kinesiology 1060A/B or Kinesiology 2222A/B; plus a minimum mark of 80% in one of Health Sciences 3300A/B or Kinesiology 3222A/B).
courses.antireqText: The former Anatomy and Cell Biology 2221.

courses.title: DISCOVERY-BASED CELL BIOLOGY I
courses.prereqText: One of Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A with a minimum mark of 70%, or Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309 with a minimum mark of 75%. The preferred prerequisite is one of Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A.

courses.title: DISCOVERY-BASED CELL BIOLOGY II
courses.prereqText: One of Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A with a minimum mark of 70%, or Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309 with a minimum mark of 75%. The preferred prerequisite is one of Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A.

courses.title: ADVANCED CLINICAL HISTOLOGY
courses.prereqText: A minimum mark of 70% in either Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309 or Pathology 3500.

courses.title: INTEGRATIVE NEUROSCIENCE
courses.prereqText: Biochemistry 2280A, Biology 2382A/B and registration in Year 4 of a basic medical science module.

courses.title: NEUROBIOLOGY OF MENTAL ILLNESS
courses.prereqText: a minimum mark of 70% in one of the following: Anatomy and Cell Biology 3200A/B, Neuroscience 2000, or the former Anatomy and Cell Biology 3319.

courses.title: TRANSLATIONAL MODELS OF CANCER
courses.prereqText: a minimum mark of 70% in one of Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309 or Pathology 3500.

courses.title: RESEARCH PROJECT AND SEMINAR
courses.prereqText: Anatomy and Cell Biology 3309 with a mark of at least 70%; Anatomy and Cell Biology 3329A/B; one of Biochemistry 3380G, Biology 3326F/G, with a mark of at least 70%; Biology 3316A/B or Physiology 3140A, with a mark of at least 70% in the course taken. Enrolment is limited and available only to students in Year 4 of the Honours Specialization in Medical Cell Biology. Corequisite(s): Anatomy and Cell Biology 4986Y.
courses.antireqText: Biochemistry 4484E, Biochemistry 4985E, Epidemiology and Biostatistics 4900E, Epidemiology and Biostatistics 4985E, Medical Bioinformatics 4985E, Medical Biophysics 4985E, Medical Sciences 4990E, Microbiology and Immunology 4985E, One Health 4985E, Pathology 4985E, Physiology and Pharmacology 4985E, the former Anatomy and Cell Biology 4480E, the former Biochemistry 4483E, the former Chemical Biology 4500E, the former Medical Bioinformatics 4980E, the former Medical Biophysics 4970E, the former Medical Biophysics 4971E, the former Microbiology and Immunology 4970E, the former One Health 4980E, the former Pathology 4980E, the former Physiology and Pharmacology 4980E.

courses.title: BEYOND THE BENCH: BUILDING SKILLS FOR SCIENTIFIC AND PROFESSIONAL SUCCESS
courses.prereqText: Registration in Year 4 of the Honours Specialization in Biochemistry and Cell Biology or Honours Specialization in Medical Cell Biology. Corequisite(s): Anatomy and Cell Biology 4985E.
